LESSON: CHEMICALS OF LIFE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BIOLOGY
Strand: Cell Biology and Biodiversity
Topic 1.4: Chemicals of Life
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 28

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Chemicals of Life, part of Cell Biology and Biodiversity in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 BIOLOGY.

Key inquiry question: How are chemicals important in cells? 2. How is the presence of chemicals of life determined?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Chemicals of Life together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem Solving: The learner analyses and makes inferences while carrying out food tests on

the various food Suggested.

• Learning to Learn: The learner examines packaging labels of common food products, appreciates the quality,

quantity and safety of the chemical components indicated.

Values:
• Love: The learner shares resources and ideas with others while carrying out experiments to determine factors

affecting enzymatic activities.

• Unity: The learner collaborates with others while carrying out experiments to investigate the presence of catalase

enzymes in living tissues.
